title: Mona Lisa / contributors

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Reveal the surrounding participants in a familiar creative story because a famous individual can obscure the wider network.
strategic_value: Recasting an iconic painting with participant labels can extend Figma’s collaboration message to people outside digital design.
demonstration: A framed black-and-white Mona Lisa is surrounded by colored roles, editing tools and cyan control marks.
practical_value: Show a familiar cultural object as a shared process through labels and editing cues.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: Center the outlined painting inside a black outer border on gray.

content_islands.name: Contributors
content_islands.spec: Distribute five labels around the portrait and pair each with a colored tool or pointer.

content_islands.name: Editing marks
content_islands.spec: Attach cyan nodes and paths to the mouth and shoulder rather than depicting a finished untouched image.

reference_purposes.Expression: The familiar portrait combines monochrome linework with colored labels and editing tools.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying narrative says the campaign debunks familiar stories of isolated genius.
